latest_message:
Dear Asantewaa,

Thank you for your thoughtful message and for taking the time to share your feedback on Trustpilot — we really appreciate it.

Being ranked as a top candidate on our platform indeed positions you as a strong contender, and this may allow your profile to be shared with other companies looking for talent. It's part of how we aim to connect top candidates with opportunities, but the final decisions are always made by the companies themselves.

Let us know if you have any questions,

Best regards,

--
Jessica from Flowmingo Customer Support Team
